patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for feature sections, pairing a large product image or device mockup with descriptive text and a call to action.
Section headings are rendered in an oversized, bold sans-serif, creating strong visual hierarchy, often contrasted with smaller, uppercase labels for categories or sub-sections.
A high-contrast dark mode theme is dominant, featuring white text on a near-black background, punctuated by a single, vibrant neon green accent color for CTAs and key highlights.

Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience. The hero background image exhibits a parallax effect, scrolling slower than foreground content.

The page is structured with distinct full-width sections, alternating between dark backgrounds and a striking full-bleed neon green background to create strong visual breaks and emphasize key messages.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that dynamically shrinks in height, gains a solid dark background, and transforms its call-to-action button style (from outline to solid fill) as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Utilize JavaScript (e.g., Intersection Observer API or a scroll animation library) to trigger subtle fade-in and upward slide animations for content blocks and product imagery as they become visible within the viewport, enhancing engagement.
Achieve a parallax effect in the hero section by having the background image scroll at a slower rate than the foreground text and elements, creating a sense of depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by clear, moderately sized body text and small, often uppercase, functional labels.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners on UI elements and content blocks, with very subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy spacing, particularly in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness, while content within feature blocks is well-spaced but not overly dense.

standout: The site's design is distinctive through its audacious and consistent application of a single, highly saturated neon green accent color against a stark dark background. This, combined with oversized, almost architectural typography for key brand elements, creates a bold, modern, and memorable identity that stands apart from typical corporate financial aesthetics.
